free_tier.stated: Two product lines. Cloud VPS S is USD 8.49/month including VAT (USD 84.90/year): 2 vCores, 4 GB, 40 GB NVMe, 1 Gbps port, unlimited traffic, IPv4 plus IPv6, root access. M is USD 15.99/month for 4 vCores, 8 GB and 75 GB; L is USD 22.99 for 6 vCores, 12 GB and 100 GB; XL is USD 43.99 for 8 vCores, 24 GB and 200 GB. Shared hosting runs from Pioneer Start at USD 2.49/month (USD 24.90/year): 5 GB SSD, 50 GB monthly traffic on the vendor page, 1 website, LVE limit 100 percent CPU and 1 GB RAM, 200 outbound messages a day. Every plan carries a 30-day money-back guarantee and the offer post adds a 3-day free trial.

egress.terms: unlimited traffic on the Cloud VPS line behind a 1 Gbps port; the shared line is metered at 50 GB a month for Pioneer Start on the vendor page and 250 GB on the offer post
egress.free_allowance: unlimited on Cloud VPS; 50 GB per month on the Pioneer Start shared plan

chaining: the useful row here is the shared line rather than the VPS: USD 2.49/month for 5 GB, 50 GB of traffic, 5 mailboxes and 200 outbound messages a day is the cheapest way among documented hosts to get a mailbox and a small site on one invoice, and the 3-day trial makes it testable without paying

limits.value: the Cloud VPS line is unlimited traffic on a 1 Gbps port, so there the port binds. The shared line carries a monthly allowance that is the wall on the cheapest plan: the vendor page states 50 GB a month for Pioneer Start against 250 GB for Grow and 500 GB for Pro, and the offer post states 250 GB for every one of the three, so the ceiling on the entry plan is disputed between the two pages. The trial is 3 days.
